purpose: Produce a restrained Delighted mouth after the previous candidate was too large and heavy. Only one small mouth mask may be exported.

locked_v9_reference.use: sole visual reference for V9 identity, exact eyes, highlights, nose, scale, and ink weight

reference_policy: The locked V9 sheet is the sole image input. All V42 generated art is inactive evidence and is not an image-generation input.
identity_locks: Keep the exact V9 open-eye body, one main highlight, one tiny sparkle, centered small rounded nose, brows, cheeks, face scale, and monochrome identity.
Do not redesign any component other than the Delighted mouth.
mouth_contract: One very small, thin, shallow smile arc with gently raised ends and a tiny narrow white opening immediately below. At native 200x200 the complete mouth is no wider than the inner eye spacing and reads as a restrained cute smile, not O, U, or surprise.
